SELECT T.menu_img, T.menu_id, T.menu_name, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(CONCAT_WS(' ',rd.ingredient_name_raw,im.ingredient_name_std,im.ingredient_name_raw)) FROM the_full_order.tb_recipe_detail rd LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master im ON im.ingredient_id=rd.ingredient_id WHERE rd.menu_id=T.menu_id) AS recipe_ingredient_names, T.del_yn, T.food_type, T.food_type_reason, DATE_FORMAT(T.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as created_at, T.menu_type, T.menu_gubun, T.meal_plan_type, T.calories_per_serving, NULL AS menu_cost_per_person FROM the_full_order.tb_menu_master T WHERE 1 = 1
AND T.meal_plan_type = #{meal_plan_type}

THEN (CASE WHEN LOWER(rd.base_unit)=LOWER(COALESCE(ap.link_base_unit,sp.base_unit,rd.base_unit)) THEN rd.qty_per_person WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='kg' AND (rd.qty_per_person)/1000 ELSE NULL END) * COALESCE(#{servingQty},1) END), 3) AS required_qty, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ib.current_base_qty), 0), 3) AS current_qty, COALESCE(MIN(ib.location_id), rd.qty_per_person WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='kg' AND LOWER(COALESCE(ap.link_base_unit,sp.base_unit,rd.base_unit))='g') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='l' AND cost_reason,cost.cost_source,cost.cost_source_date FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master im ON im.account_id=rd.account_id AND im.ingredient_id=rd.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN () cost ON cost.account_recipe_detail_id=rd.account_recipe_detail_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON (CASE WHEN ${row}.effective_from>${costDateSql} THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,${costDateSql},${row}.effective_from) WHEN ${row}.effective_to IS NOT NULL AND ${row}.effective_to<=${costDateSql} THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,${row}.effective_to,${costDateSql}),1) ELSE 0 END)

SELECT s.*, CASE s.auto_source WHEN 'SITE_PRICE' THEN s.site_cost WHEN 'COMMON_PRICE' THEN s.common_cost WHEN 'SITE_PRICE_NEAREST' THEN s.site_cost WHEN 'COMMON_PRICE_NEAREST' THEN s.common_cost WHEN 'RECENT_RECEIPT' THEN s.receipt_cost WHEN 'INVENTORY_AVERAGE' THEN s.inventory_cost END auto_unit_cost, CASE s.auto_source WHEN 'SITE_PRICE' THEN s.site_date WHEN 'COMMON_PRICE' THEN s.common_date WHEN 'SITE_PRICE_NEAREST' THEN s.site_date WHEN 'COMMON_PRICE_NEAREST' THEN s.common_date WHEN 'RECENT_RECEIPT' THEN s.receipt_date WHEN 'INVENTORY_AVERAGE' THEN DATE(${costDateSql}) END auto_source_date FROM ( SELECT c.*, CASE WHEN c.site_dist=0 AND c.site_cost>0 THEN 'SITE_PRICE' WHEN c.common_dist=0 AND c.common_cost>0 THEN 'COMMON_PRICE' WHEN c.site_cost>0 THEN 'SITE_PRICE_NEAREST' WHEN c.common_cost>0 THEN 'COMMON_PRICE_NEAREST' WHEN c.receipt_cost>0 THEN 'RECENT_RECEIPT' WHEN c.inventory_cost>0 THEN 'INVENTORY_AVERAGE' END auto_source FROM ( SELECT ap.account_id,ap.mapped_ingredient_id ingredient_id,ap.account_ingredient_product_id,p.supplier_product_id, COALESCE(ap.link_base_unit,p.base_unit) base_unit,COALESCE(ap.link_base_qty,p.base_qty) base_qty, CASE WHEN pc.source_type='MANUAL' THEN pc.unit_cost* END manual_cost, DATE(pc.confirmed_at) manual_date, sp.purchase_price/NULLIF(COALESCE(ap.link_base_qty,p.base_qty),0) site_cost, site_dist,DATE(sp.effective_from) site_date, mh.purchase_price/NULLIF(COALESCE(ap.link_base_qty,p.base_qty),0) common_cost, common_dist,DATE(mh.effective_from) common_date, lot.receipt_unit_cost* receipt_cost, lot.received_date receipt_date, (SELECT SUM(b.current_base_qty*b.average_unit_cost) /NULLIF(SUM(b.current_base_qty/),0) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b WHERE b.account_ingredient_product_id=ap.account_ingredient_product_id AND b.current_base_qty>0 HAVING MIN(b.average_unit_cost)>0 AND COUNT()=COUNT(*)) inventory_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ap.account_id,ap.mapped_ingredient_id ORDER BY ap.preferred_yn DESC,ap.mod_at DESC,ap.account_ingredient_product_id DESC) choice_rank FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id AND p.active_yn='Y' LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_planning_cost pc ON pc.planning_cost_id=( SELECT h.planning_cost_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_planning_cost h WHERE h.account_id=ap.account_id AND h.ingredient_id=ap.mapped_ingredient_id AND h.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id ORDER BY h.planning_cost_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price sp ON sp.supplier_price_id=( SELECT h.supplier_price_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price h JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o ON o.supplier_offer_id=h.supplier_offer_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site a ON a.supplier_account_site_id=o.supplier_account_site_id WHERE a.account_id=ap.account_id AND a.active_yn='Y' AND o.active_yn='Y' AND o.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND h.purchase_price>0 ORDER BY ,h.effective_from DESC,h.supplier_price_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history mh ON mh.price_history_id=( SELECT h.price_history_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history h WHERE h.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND h.purchase_price>0 ORDER BY ,h.effective_from DESC,h.price_history_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot lot ON lot.inventory_lot_id=( SELECT l.inventory_lot_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_ingredient_product_id=ap.account_ingredient_product_id AND l.receipt_unit_cost>0 ORDER
